reviewers: 3 fresh Opus 5.5, parallel; a major counts only if 2 of 3 raise it
evidence: /tmp/gatechk/r34 (6x strip, 4x same-scale with shipped jp counters, 1x/3x map scenes)

minors: Tread edges zigzag left/right row to row (left outline jagged, step widths alternate) so at 6x it reads a little like stacked wooden crates/tiered shelf; reads fine as stairs in house-1f at 1x/3x
Low contrast between lit tread band and riser in the wood palette; steps blur together at 1x
Strong one-point taper toward north conflicts with the parallel-sided down stairwells and orthographic furniture of the set
In house-1f it sits beside the tall wardrobe at the same dark-wood value, so at 1x the two blend into one dark brown column and the stair reads weaker than the furniture
Sides taper inward toward the top (one-point perspective), while the jp stairwell-down pieces have straight sides, so the projection is inconsistent within the set
1-wide treads are almost uniform width, little narrowing toward the hole, so the climb reads flatter than the 2-wide versions
in the house-1f scene at 3x the dark brown on the dark floor blends into the corridor and reads mainly as a dark chute; tread highlight bands are faint
Only the left side has a light stringer/rail; right edge just stops against the dark recess, asymmetric
At 1x in mansion-lobby the pale narrow column could pass for a locker/shelf at a glance; context (recess under ceiling hole) saves it
Perspective taper inconsistent with set projection
At 1x in mansion-lobby the 1-wide pale treads with bright left edge read close to a stacked shelf/rack in a wall niche; the tread/riser contrast is fine at 3x but marginal at 1x
Top-tapered sides (perspective convergence) unlike straight-sided stairwells
at 1x in the mansion lobby the grey 1-wide stair beside the corkboard can briefly pass for a metal shelving unit; it reads as stairs at 3x
the left stringer outline is a lighter grey than the right one, so the stringers look asymmetric
Same pixels as mc-stairs-up: only left stringer, right side open
Perspective taper inconsistent with set projection
Same pixels as mc: weak at 1x, it reads a bit like a small shelf in the dark recess of office-1f
Tapered sides
same pixels as mc-stairs-up; in office-1f it sits in a pale room with little contrast and the bottom tread merges with the floor
Dashed dark diagonal rails read more like stitching than a handrail
Right rail drops into a short light vertical post at bottom right while the left side has no matching post; asymmetric
In school-2f it sits directly beside the parallel-sided sc-stairwell-down; the strong one-point convergence of the up stair clashes with the orthographic down stair and the rest of the set
Diagonal side rails are drawn as jagged, dashed 1px lines (stair-stepped aliasing with dots) instead of a clean stringer; at 3x they look broken
Strong taper toward the top is one-point perspective, which disagrees with the straight-sided sc-stairwell-down right next to it in school-2f
strong trapezoid convergence (vanishing-point look) is steeper than the set's oblique 3/4 furniture, but it still reads correctly
the right-side vertical rail stub at the bottom right ends abruptly without a matching left post
Rail only on right side, ends in a vertical post at the bottom; left side has no stringer
Perspective taper inconsistent with set projection
Same jagged dashed diagonal rails as sc
Tapered perspective
the dark red-brown backing wall around the stair is a different hue from the shipped wood floors and makes the piece look boxed in
Orange/red cross cluster on the bottom-left tread reads as a stray object (flower/sparkle) rather than debris
Isolated dark-red pixels on the right stringer read as stray noise/blood
Ivy strand hangs on the far left edge outside the stair, touching the tile boundary
Orange plus-shaped cluster on the bottom-left tread reads like a pickup sparkle or flame, not debris
Red dots on the right stringer read as stray pixels rather than rust
Ivy is limited to the left frame edge and looks pasted on
the ivy strand at the far left spills outside the stair frame along the edge and looks pasted on
the orange/red speck cluster at the lower left reads as a small flower or object, not debris
the dark rubble blocks on the middle treads look like small boxes

majors: No stringers/side walls at all and every tread steps out 1px on both sides, so the silhouette is a stepped ziggurat/tiered dais (wedding-cake outline) rather than a flight of stairs climbing north
minors: Background behind the flight is split (darker left, lighter right panel), making the piece look off-center
Perspective taper inconsistent with set projection
No left stringer: tread ends step diagonally into the background, so the left edge looks unfinished
Scattered dark speckles on treads read as noise
the right third is a flat darker wall panel with no stringer edge, so the piece looks lopsided next to the symmetric others

note: 0 majority majors on jp kits, but the up-stair art changed afterwards (gate flat-fill); superseded by r32.
